title: Turn Any Image Into a 3D Model Free With Hunyuan3D
description:
Comment "AI" and I'll send the link to your DMs 📩

China just released an AI tool that turns any image into a high-quality 3D model — free and open source.

The results are clean enough to sell on marketplaces like Sketchfab and TurboSquid.

The workflow 👇
1️⃣ Upload your image
2️⃣ Hit Generate Shape for the preview mesh
3️⃣ Like it? Generate Textured Shape
4️⃣ Download your finished 3D model in seconds

Game assets, product mockups, 3D printing — whatever you need.

👉 Follow me and comment "AI" and I'll DM you the link

#3dmodeling #hunyuan3d #gamedev #AItools #opensource
